assets.label: @keeper
assets.look: Human woman, 1.68 metres tall, approximately sixty years old, with narrow shoulders, weathered hands, a lined face and grey hair tied back; wearing a heavy charcoal coat, dark trousers and practical boots.

assets.label: @shell
assets.look: Spiral seashell, 6 centimetres long, with an ivory surface, fine amber striations and a slightly chipped lip.

assets.label: @beach
assets.look: Intertidal beach, approximately 300 metres long and 30 metres wide, with wet sand, embedded rock shelves, shallow tidal depressions and a rising landward path.

assets.label: @lighthouse
assets.look: Lighthouse tower, 24 metres tall and 6 metres across, with salt-stained white masonry, narrow windows and a glass lantern enclosure.

assets.label: @cottage
assets.look: Single-storey cottage, 7 metres long and 6 metres wide, attached to the base of the tower, with a landward entrance and a 4-by-3-metre kitchen containing faded blue plaster walls, worn wooden flooring and a shore-facing window.

assets.label: @table
assets.look: Kitchen table, 1.2 metres long, 75 centimetres wide and 74 centimetres high, made of worn dark wood with four square legs.

assets.label: @cup
assets.look: Ceramic drinking cup, 9 centimetres tall and 8 centimetres across, with off-white glaze, a blue rim, one handle and a chip beside the handle.
